Global Reach
End-to-End Encrypted
Every message secured in transit. Built on Firebase with industry-standard auth and real-time sync.
Peer Wellness Network
24/7 anonymous peer support with trained counselors. Crisis resources always one tap away.
Study Room Mode
Collaborative Pomodoro sessions, shared goal tracking, and focus metrics — built into every group chat.
AI-Powered Translation
Break language barriers — any message can be instantly translated, enabling truly global collaboration.
Proximity Discovery
Find researchers and students in your building, campus or city — like Telegram People Nearby, for academia.
NF AI Assistant
Context-aware AI — summarise conversations, draft responses, get academic writing help, all in-app.
Technology should lower barriers, not raise them. NeuroForge was built on the belief that a well-connected student community — with the right support systems — performs better, stays healthier, and creates more lasting impact on the world.

Slide to agree with our community rules.

1. Respect & Conduct

All members must treat others with dignity. Harassment, hate speech, discrimination, bullying, or any form of targeted abuse is strictly prohibited and will result in an immediate permanent ban.

2. Privacy & Data

Your messages and personal data are secured. NeuroForge does not sell your data. You have full control over your online status, read receipts, and profile visibility through the settings panel.

3. Community Moderation

NeuroForge administrators and moderators reserve the right to restrict, mute, kick, or permanently ban accounts that violate these guidelines — with or without prior warning, at their sole discretion.

4. Channels & Content

Do not share illegal, NSFW, or harmful content in public channels. Channel owners are responsible for moderating their own spaces. Violations reported to admins will be actioned swiftly.

5. Account Security

You are responsible for the security of your account. Never share your login credentials. Any suspicious activity must be reported to an admin immediately.

6. Governing Terms

These terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of NeuroForge after changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised terms. We will notify users of major changes via the in-app notification system.
